objects.prompt: “Top-down 2D pixel art asset for a narrative indie game, RPG Maker horror/mystery style, true 16-bit fidelity, crisp pixel edges, limited muted palette, 2–3 shading steps per surface, no smooth gradients, no painterly rendering, no heavy anti-aliasing. A dense green forest bush used as a natural barrier along the sides of a straight dirt road. Rounded leafy mass, thick and full, with uneven organic edges and small leaf clusters, readable at game scale. The bush should look healthy and Eden-like, not dead, not thorny, not sinister. It should be dense enough to visually tell the player they cannot walk through it, but still beautiful and natural. High three-quarter top-down view, neutral flat daylight base lighting only, no baked shadow, no glow, no nighttime tint. Transparent background.”
